tagline: An international provider of shipping transportation services
hero_kpi_rationale: No distinctive wow factor identified. The maritime sector has no meaningful AI or cloud segment. Revenue is the primary performance indicator.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned from leasing container ships.
kpis.description: Revenue increased in 2025 compared to 2024, driven by sustained demand and long-term charter contracts.
kpis.signal: Solid growth supported by elevated freight rates.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Profit generated before interest and taxes relative to revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin is improving slightly, reflecting strong operational discipline despite cost inflation.
kpis.signal: High margins driven by efficient OPEX management.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Money spent to purchase or modernize ships.
kpis.description: CAPEX declined in 2025, indicating a stabilization phase for the fleet after prior expansions.
kpis.signal: Marked reduction in capital investments in 2025.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.explanation: Number of employees employed by the company.
kpis.description: Headcount remains stable, with the company outsourcing ship operations to technical managers.
kpis.signal: Lean structure and highly outsourced model typical of the sector.

ai_positioning.summary: Costamare mentions no AI-related initiatives in its reports. The company operates in traditional maritime transport with no signals of advanced technology adoption.
evidence: No mention of AI in the 2025 20-F
No digital projects or technology innovation initiatives reported
Exclusive focus on fleet management and charter contracts
